Project overview

Outcomes and activities

Project brief

Principal Investigator: Solar-assisted heat pump dryer integrated with energy storage system for drying biomaterials, Grant ref: RSIF/RA/001, funded by PASET Africa Regional Scholarship and Innovation Fund (RSIF) for Applied Sciences, Engineering and Technology. Project partners include Alpha Thermal Process, LLC from USA.

  • Capacity building: The project provided partial scholarships to two students (1 MSc and 1 PhD). We developed an affordable Solar-assisted heat pump dryer integrated with energy storage system for drying biomaterials. The dryer is patented by the Business Registrations and Licensing Agency (BRELA) in Tanzania, with Patent no. TZ/P/2023/000093. We raised awareness among various stakeholders, reaching over 100 individuals, about the use of the technology through workshops and site visits. We trained two women's groups—the Mwambesi Group from Arusha and the Efeso Women's Group from Moshi-Kilimanjaro—on making capsules from powdered dried products and provided each group with a capsule-making machine. Published three articles in Web of Science listed journals
